name: maxSpeed
meaning: target speed at full stick deflection, u/s (Mobile_Steer: maxSpeed * stickMag >> 8)

name: deceleration
meaning: Math_ApproachLinear rate when slowing; Mobile_Steer brakes at (acceleration+deceleration)/2 when the stick points backwards

name: verticalRate
meaning: not read by the steering functions; name

name: maxTravelTurnRate
meaning: angular speed limit for the motion heading

name: maxFacingTurnRate
meaning: angular speed limit for the facing

name: travelTurnAcceleration
meaning: angular acceleration for the motion heading (also passed as the facing's deceleration)

name: returnAngleThreshold
meaning: a stick further than this from the motion heading makes Mobile_Steer return 1
